**Dublin South-West** is a [parliamentary constituency](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dáil_constituencies "Dáil constituencies") represented in [Dáil Éireann](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dáil_Éireann "Dáil Éireann"), the lower house of the Irish parliament or [Oireachtas](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Oireachtas "Oireachtas"). The constituency elects five deputies ([Teachtaí Dála](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Teachta_Dála "Teachta Dála"), commonly known as TDs) on the system of [proportional representation](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Proportional_representation "Proportional representation") by means of the [single transferable vote](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Single_transferable_vote "Single transferable vote") (PR-STV).

## Constituency profile

[[edit](/w/index.php?title=Dublin_South-West&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section: Constituency profile")]

The constituency leans towards left-wing parties such as the [Labour Party](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Labour_Party_(Ireland) "Labour Party (Ireland)") and [Sinn Féin](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sinn_Féin "Sinn Féin"). Both Labour Party TDs elected in 2011 had been members of other left-wing parties: Pat Rabbitte of the [Workers' Party](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Workers'_Party_(Ireland) "Workers' Party (Ireland)") and [Democratic Left](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Democratic_Left_(Ireland) "Democratic Left (Ireland)"), and [Eamonn Maloney](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eamonn_Maloney "Eamonn Maloney") was a member of the [Jim Kemmy](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jim_Kemmy "Jim Kemmy")'s [Democratic Socialist Party](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Democratic_Socialist_Party_(Ireland) "Democratic Socialist Party (Ireland)"). With the departure of [Brian Hayes](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Brian_Hayes_(politician) "Brian Hayes (politician)") in 2014, upon the election of [Paul Murphy](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Paul_Murphy_(Irish_politician) "Paul Murphy (Irish politician)") of the [Anti-Austerity Alliance](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Anti-Austerity_Alliance "Anti-Austerity Alliance") in the [2014 by-election](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2014_Dublin_South-West_by-election "2014 Dublin South-West by-election"), the constituency was entirely represented by four left-of-centre TDs until the 2016 election.
